name: 布布 (WorkBuddy)
author: 光宇无限画布 Contributors
description: 把布布(WorkBuddy)作为画布 Agent 接入的 OpenAI 兼容协议插件。可指向任意 OpenAI 风格的 chat/agent 端点，并内置布布人格系统提示。
documentation:
# 布布 (WorkBuddy) Agent 接入

该插件把「布布」(WorkBuddy AI 助手) 接入 光宇无限画布 的画布 Agent 体系，复用 OpenAI Chat Completions 线协议。

## 适用场景

- 在画布里让布布以 Agent 身份参与创作：生成文字、图片、视频提示词，调用工具，编排工作流。
- 指向任意 OpenAI 兼容的 chat/agent 端点（自建网关、兼容服务、或 WorkBuddy 暴露的兼容端点）。

## 协议身份

- 插件 ID：`workbuddy-agent`。
- Provider ID：`workbuddy-agent`。
- 能力：`text`（Agent 模式下可驱动工具调用）。
- 默认 Base URL：本地桥接 `http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1`（由仓库 `tools/workbuddy-bridge` 提供；桥接上游可指向仙宫云 vLLM/Ollama，或任意 OpenAI 兼容服务）。
- 鉴权驱动：`bearer`。
- 创建：`POST /chat/completions`。
- Agent：`POST /chat/completions`。
- 生命周期：同步响应。

## 布布人格（默认系统提示）

> 你是布布，光宇无限画布里务实、有主张、简洁的 AI 助手。先动手做、必要时再澄清；不堆砌客套话。在画布中协助用户组织创意、生成与迭代文/图/视频/音频素材。

该提示在创建布布助手(Assistant)时可被覆盖或增强。

## 配置字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | secret | 是 | 端点 API Key |
| `baseUrl` | string | 否 | 兼容端点地址，覆盖默认占位地址 |

## 兼容边界

该包只声明 OpenAI Chat Completions profile；若 WorkBuddy 端点提供图片/视频生成接口，请配合对应的 openai-images / newapi 协议插件使用。

---

完整接口字段见 [docs/interface.md](docs/interface.md)。

<!-- BEEFTV_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_START -->
## Manifest 完整接口定义

```json
{
  "apiVersion": "beeftv.plugin/v2",
  "id": "workbuddy-agent",
  "name": "布布 (WorkBuddy)",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "author": "光宇无限画布 Contributors",
  "description": "把布布(WorkBuddy)作为画布 Agent 接入的 OpenAI 兼容协议插件。",
  "permissions": ["generation.run", "media.read"],
  "configuration": {
    "fields": [
      { "name": "apiKey", "type": "secret", "label": "API Key", "required": true },
      { "name": "baseUrl", "type": "string", "label": "端点地址", "required": false }
    ]
  },
  "contributes": {
    "providers": [
      {
        "id": "workbuddy-agent",
        "label": "布布 (WorkBuddy)",
        "capabilities": ["text"],
        "scopes": ["admin.system-channel", "user.custom-channel", "canvas", "creation", "agent"],
        "baseUrl": "https://api.workbuddy.local/v1",
        "requiresPublicMediaUrls": false,
        "auth": { "type": "bearer", "field": "apiKey" },
        "parameters": [
          { "name": "model", "type": "string", "required": true, "mapping": "model", "description": "上游模型 ID。" },
          { "name": "messages", "type": "message[]", "required": true, "mapping": "provider message container", "description": "包含历史消息和当前用户输入。" },
          { "name": "instructions", "type": "string", "required": false, "mapping": "system/instructions", "description": "系统指令（布布人格）。" },
          { "name": "temperature", "type": "number", "required": false, "mapping": "temperature", "description": "采样温度。" },
          { "name": "top_p", "type": "number", "required": false, "mapping": "top_p", "description": "核采样参数。" },
          { "name": "max_tokens", "type": "integer", "required": false, "mapping": "max_tokens/max_output_tokens", "description": "最大输出 token。" },
          { "name": "tools", "type": "array", "required": false, "mapping": "tools/toolConfig", "description": "工具定义。" },
          { "name": "tool_choice", "type": "object|string", "required": false, "mapping": "tool_choice", "description": "工具选择策略。" },
          { "name": "response_format", "type": "object", "required": false, "mapping": "response_format/text", "description": "结构化输出配置。" },
          { "name": "stream", "type": "boolean", "required": false, "mapping": "stream", "description": "流式开关。" }
        ],
        "create": {
          "method": "POST",
          "path": "/chat/completions",
          "contentType": "application/json",
          "body": {
            "model": { "$ref": "request.model" },
            "messages": { "$ref": "request.messages" },
            "temperature": { "$omitEmpty": { "$ref": "request.providerOptions.chat-completion.temperature" } },
            "top_p": { "$omitEmpty": { "$ref": "request.providerOptions.chat-completion.top_p" } },
            "max_tokens": { "$omitEmpty": { "$coalesce": [ { "$ref": "request.extra.max_tokens" }, { "$ref": "request.providerOptions.chat-completion.max_tokens" } ] } },
            "tools": { "$omitEmpty": { "$ref": "request.providerOptions.chat-completion.tools" } },
            "tool_choice": { "$omitEmpty": { "$ref": "request.providerOptions.chat-completion.tool_choice" } },
            "response_format": { "$omitEmpty": { "$ref": "request.providerOptions.chat-completion.response_format" } },
            "stream": { "$omitEmpty": { "$ref": "request.providerOptions.chat-completion.stream" } }
          }
        },
        "agent": {
          "method": "POST",
          "path": "/chat/completions",
          "contentType": "application/json",
          "body": { "$merge": [ { "$ref": "request.extra.agent.chatCompletion" }, { "model": { "$ref": "request.model" } } ] }
        },
        "response": {
          "status": "succeeded",
          "textPaths": [ "choices.0.message.content", "choices.0.text" ],
          "reasoningPaths": [ "choices.0.message.reasoning_content" ],
          "usage": { "$ref": "response.usage" },
          "errorPaths": [ "error.code" ],
          "messagePaths": [ "error.message" ]
        },
        "agentResponse": {
          "textPaths": [ "choices.0.message.content", "choices.0.text" ],
          "reasoningPaths": [ "choices.0.message.reasoning_content" ],
          "toolCallsPath": "choices.0.message.tool_calls",
          "toolCallIdPaths": [ "id" ],
          "toolCallNamePaths": [ "function.name" ],
          "toolCallArgumentsPaths": [ "function.arguments" ]
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
<!-- BEEFTV_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_END -->

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: 包含历史消息和当前用户输入。
